source.locator: Native ERC and DRC must pass and the netlist must export.

requirements.statement: Native ERC and DRC pass and the netlist exports

source.locator: Copper tracks must be at least 0.20 mm wide.

requirements.statement: Copper tracks and arcs are at least 0.20 mm wide

source.locator: With an ideal unloaded 1 V step at /IN, /OUT at 1 ms must be between 0.62 V and 0.65 V inclusive.

requirements.statement: Unloaded 1 V step response at /OUT at 1 ms in [0.62,0.65] V

source.locator: R1 and C1 are JLCPCB-assembled SMD parts

requirements.statement: The board yields a JLCPCB assembly package: Gerbers, drill, BOM and CPL

source.locator: A 10k resistor R1 connects /IN to /OUT, and a 100n capacitor C1 connects /OUT to GND.

requirements.statement: R1 (10k, /IN to /OUT) and C1 (100n, /OUT to GND) are exported populated parts, each bound to an LCSC part in the BOM

limitations: Ideal unloaded step response only; tolerance, temperature, loading, ADC sampling, EMI and hardware behavior are untested.
Zone fill is evaluated as saved; the read-only candidate forbids a refill pass.
fab_export checks that the package exports and that every BOM line is bound; stock, price, DFM and fab_consistency are not evaluated.

Not checked: "A 3-pin header J1 carries the input /IN on pin 1, the output /OUT on pin 2 and GND on pin 3." (header pin assignment needs a hardware_interface contract, which is not in the rung-1 check list)

Not checked: "The board is a 2-layer 50 mm x 30 mm rectangle with J1 on the left edge." (outline, layer count and connector edge need the board_envelope check (AGENTEE-85), which is not in the rung-1 check list)

Not checked: "SMD parts; the through-hole header J1 is hand-soldered." (package class and hand-solder assembly class are not checked; fab_export requires an LCSC binding for every non-DNP BOM line, including J1)
name: Rung-1 RC low-pass board
scope: Review the rung-1 RC low-pass board generated from the one-paragraph spec against the requirement IDs compiled from it. This is a disposable benchmark board, not an ECU circuit.
